lines: gm {first} 🌅 Gavin here. {friendfirst} says you're 'good with your hands'.
gm gm {first} 🌅 it's Gavin. yes, THAT Gavin. {friendfirst} talks about you constantly. mostly in the group chat.
I'm building something. Can't say what. It's on-chain. You'd be employee #0 (#1 is taken, by me).
just say the word and I'll send you a whitepaper. it's one page. the page is blank. that's the vision.
few understand.
'{reply}'. love that energy. few understand.
the ones who do are brawling on the trading floor right now. come watch. not financial advice. 📈
Darling! Bev Fizzwilliam, BSN. I'm at your friend's DAO launch party. 🥂
Free bar, no chairs, and a man called Gavin explaining money to a fountain. The fountain looks convinced.
The theme is 'decentralised'. Nobody knows where the canapés are. Very on brand, darling.
We're running a little piece tonight and your name came up. Twice. In a good way, mostly. To you, darling! 🥂

LIVE from the launch of a decentralised autonomous organisation, darling! 🥂 Head of Vibes {friend} gave a speech about 'the future'. Gavin gave a speech about Gavin. Nobody could find the exit, which I'm told is the business model. Back to you, Brock.

Tonight's launch: a DAO! 🥂 The champagne is real, the money is theoretical, and the Head of Vibes, {friend}, is doing a wonderful job of not reading the contract. Cheers, darlings. Back to the studio.
Hey there! Brock Stetson Jr., BSN. Huge fan. HUGE.
Folks are saying you took down {lastboss} in a final interview! We want your comment for tonight's show.
Keep it short. The teleprompter only goes so fast. I read it myself!
"{reply}" WOW. That's going straight on the teleprompter. Chills, buddy.
You're on BSN tonight! Look for the lower third. I spelled your name myself, so it's probably right.
BREAKING: {me} beats {lastboss} in a final interview! 🎸 "{reply}", says {first}. Folks, I've read the report. Well, I've held it. More at eleven!
TONIGHT ON BSN: a final interview turns into a final INTERVIEW. 🎸 {me} on beating {lastboss}: "{reply}" Incredible stuff. Stay with us!
Greetings, {first}. I am {delegate}, delegate for {country} at the Summit Hall.
Word of your… interviews has reached the Summit. Forty nations, one hall, an extremely contested buffet.
Should you wish to declare a nationality, your profile now has a space for it. Countries that do well at the Summit lend their people a little swagger.
(Kevin sent an attachment: untitled.txt, 0 KB)
hey. so. funny story.
the DAO voted to dissolve itself. then it voted to dissolve the vote. then Gavin left for a 'retreat'.
the DAO has 'completed its journey'. that's what Gavin said. from a boat.
I'm… open to work? 🥲
'{reply}'. noted. I'll bring snacks. and the DAO's beanbags. they're the only asset left.
'{reply}'. fair. I'll bring snacks. and the beanbags. the beanbags are non-negotiable.
see you in the line-up 💛

Some personal news: the DAO I co-led has completed its journey. 🚀 Our treasury is now a rug, our rug is now a metaphor, and I'm thrilled to be joining my oldest friend {me} at {mycompany}. Gavin, if you're reading this from the boat: few understand.

After a transformative chapter in Web3, I'm returning to brawling. 🙏 Huge thanks to {me} for taking me back, and to the DAO for teaching me that 'decentralised' means nobody knows where the money went.
